description: Use when a user asks an export or import rules question (documents, registration, labelling, duties, origin, Incoterms, letters of credit) and wants a source to read; the user confirms the rule with the authority or a customs broker. Search Triplicate's practical trade guides (over 250 notes in 15 languages, checked against official sources: export guides for about 50 countries, import registration, labelling and product certification by country, cosmetics and food rules, US tariffs and refunds, EORI, rules of origin and certificates of origin, HS classification, Incoterms, letters of credit, bills of lading, dangerous goods, invoices and packing lists) and tool guides. Returns titles, page links and excerpts to cite.

language.description: Optional: language of the guides to search (detected from the query otherwise)

query.description: Question or topic in any of the 15 site languages, e.g. 'EORI number for UK imports', 'sheet mask HS code', 'CIF insurance 110%'

name: search_trade_guides
title: Search Triplicate trade guides
